old_problem: Historical review correctly rejected the title-based single-sensor shortcut but treated missing list numbers 3–5 as possible hidden requirements. The source contains no text for those numbers; inventing it would add unsupported coverage. Exact processor sensor population, values, cross-surface mapping and Web behavior are project-specific but can be supplied as runtime configuration.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict. The explicit source requirements are complete enough to implement: reconcile all required processor sensors and fields across four IPMI inventories and the full WebUI against a versioned Project SPEC. A numbering gap alone is an editorial defect, not evidence of unwritten criteria; ED-01/30 prohibit inventing them. IPMI tooling authoritatively supports full SDR and sensor-list reads. Exact sensor names/topology/values, normalization and UI mapping are Project Configuration under ED-03, while ED-08 requires real visual Web evidence. No log clear or title-as-sensor shortcut is allowed.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2011, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, ED-01 through ED-30 and ipmitool/OpenBMC documentation were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2012 / Wistron-HW-00482-V002 / ae8124320a145891.

The ipmitool implementation enumerates full/compact SDR sensor records for `sensor list`; `sdr elist` and `sensor list` are standard read paths, so the four required inventories are executable without guessing one sensor name.
The testcase title is not a guaranteed SDR ID. Processor membership must come from a signed physical/socket/die-to-SDR/Web mapping and complete raw lists must precede filtering.
Criteria explicitly state three comparisons. The labels 1, 2 and 6 are preserved as a source numbering defect; there is no text or approved rule from which to reconstruct criteria 3–5.
Exact expected population/readings, units, status, thresholds, freshness/rounding and UI pagination are normal Project SPEC inputs; absence makes execution NOT READY rather than review Pending.
No ipmitool, authentication, sensor read, Web login/capture, log clear, BMC, host, CPU or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Complete processor sensor SPEC reconciliation across IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web
test_case.purpose: Prove the complete approved processor-sensor population and every required name, description, reading and semantic field match the versioned SPEC consistently across in-band SDR/Sensor List, out-of-band SDR/Sensor List and the full BMC Web Sensor view.
required_package: Exact SUT/BMC/BIOS/CPU socket-die topology and versioned processor-sensor SPEC with required records, units, states, thresholds and applicability
Stable per-sensor physical-to-IB-SDR/IB-list/OOB-SDR/OOB-list/Web crosswalk including record IDs and allowed aliases
Approved ipmitool build, in-band permissions, certificate/host-validated management access and protected OOB/Web credentials
Aligned sampling, dynamic-reading tolerance, rounding, stale/unavailable/disabled, duplicate/missing/extra and Web pagination/caching rules
Screenshot/export redaction/hash policy, preserved pre/post anomaly logs and human WebUI evidence/verdict ownership
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; bind exact SUT/BMC/CPU identities and preserve logs without clearing. At aligned timestamps capture complete untruncated in-band `ipmitool sdr elist` and `ipmitool sensor list`, then complete OOB equivalents using protected secrets and trusted management transport. Apply only the approved processor crosswalk after raw capture; never use the testcase title as a sensor ID or grep/head as sole evidence. Capture every BMC Web Sensor page with target/time/navigation context. Normalize each mapped record and compare name, description, reading/unit/status/threshold/freshness plus population against SPEC and across all five views. Perform no writes, threshold/config changes or automatic retries.
test_case.expected_result: Every required processor sensor appears exactly as specified in all applicable IB/OOB/Web representations with correct name/description and SPEC-valid reading semantics at aligned time; no required member is missing/duplicated, no unexpected member is silently accepted, all Web pages are visibly evidenced and no disallowed anomaly appears.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete untruncated raw inventories, full Web visual evidence and per-sensor SPEC/cross-view agreement for every required field under approved tolerance/freshness rules. FAIL on missing/extra/duplicate required mapping, wrong identity/name/description/unit/state/threshold, out-of-range/stale/unavailable reading, IB/OOB/Web mismatch, truncated/paginated omission or new disallowed log event. Missing SPEC/mapping/tolerance is NOT READY; numbering 1/2/6 alone neither adds hidden checks nor causes PASS; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Read-only collection only; prohibit sensor/threshold/BMC configuration writes and log clearing.
Use protected credentials and trusted host/certificate validation; redact secrets while retaining target/session/time identity.
Capture full inventories before approved processor filtering and all Web pages; stop on wrong SUT/channel, missing/duplicate mapping or malformed/stale data.
No automatic retry; preserve first discrepancy, raw outputs, screenshots and logs for owner review.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant, SUT/BMC/BIOS/CPU topology and ipmitool/browser identities
Versioned processor SPEC and complete physical-to-five-view sensor crosswalk/tolerance policy
Complete timestamped IB and OOB SDR elist/Sensor list raw outputs, exit status and hashes
Complete redacted BMC Web screenshots/export including navigation, pagination, target and timestamp
Per-sensor normalized SPEC/IB/OOB/Web matrix with population and missing/extra/duplicate analysis
Numbering-defect audit, preserved anomaly logs, no-write/no-clear/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On access, identity, list, Web, mapping, freshness or comparison failure, stop read-only collection, close/revoke sessions and preserve the first outputs/screenshots/logs. Rotate any exposed secret. Do not clear logs, change sensors/thresholds or retry insecurely; escalate to the BMC/platform owner with the exact discrepant record IDs.

source_conflict.reason: The explicit three criteria are executable; the 1/2/6 labels are retained as an editorial defect, while no unsupported hidden criteria are invented. DeepSeek's single-title query is rejected.
